atomik.arpeggiator: Turns the notes you hold into a tempo-synced figure: pick an order, a rate and a number of octaves, and edit the step row for rests, ties and accents.
atomik.audio-track: The device behind an audio track: it plays the audio clips of its track and takes the audio input when the track records.
atomik.auto-filter: A filter whose cutoff an LFO and the input level sweep, so a sound opens and closes with the music.
atomik.bus: An output bus of the console. Channels and other buses route into it; it has its own fader, pan, inserts and sends.
atomik.channel: A console channel: the mixer strip of one instrument or audio track, with input trim, EQ, compressor, inserts, sends, pan and fader.
atomik.character: A stereo insert with sixteen character presets in a four by four matrix. The Transform knob morphs between them, with dry and wet and volume.
atomik.clipper: A stereo clipper: the signal is driven into a ceiling through a curve from a hard clip to a soft knee, with oversampling and a multiband mode.
atomik.compressor: A stereo compressor with a sidechain input: set the threshold, ratio, attack, release and make-up gain.
atomik.container: A device whose inside is another rack: it has its own sockets and macro knobs and opens to show what it holds.
atomik.convolver: A reverb made from a recorded impulse. Drop a sample on it and the sound plays as if it were in that space.
atomik.cv-math: Arithmetic on two control voltages, with a scale and an offset on the result.
atomik.cv-quantizer: Snaps a pitch control voltage to the nearest note of a scale.
atomik.cv-sequencer: The step sequencer's note row plus two rows of control voltage, with patterns that can be chained.
atomik.de-esser: Turns down sibilance in its own band, or across the whole signal.
atomik.distortion: Oversampled saturation, waveshaping and bit crushing, with a choice of curves, tone cuts and a mix.
atomik.drum-generator: A drum pattern player that varies what is written: it adds density, variation and fills, and plays the pads of the drum machine.
atomik.drum-machine: A 16-pad sample player. Each pad plays a sample or a built-in drum voice, with velocity layers, its own tuning, envelope, filter, level and output.
atomik.dual-layer: Two Poly Synth layers played together as one instrument. Each layer has its own oscillators, filters, envelopes and LFOs, and both hear the same notes.
atomik.duck: Pumping and ducking from the song position, from the hits of a key, from the key's level, or along a curve you draw or learn.
atomik.dynamic-eq: A five-band equaliser whose bands move with the level of the signal, or of a key signal, in their own range: a resonance is cut only while it sounds.
atomik.dynamics: A gate followed by a compressor, with input gain, make-up and mix.
atomik.echo: A stereo echo whose repeats can be coloured, wobbled, diffused, crushed and ducked, with normal, triggered and roll modes.
atomik.env-filter: A filter whose cutoff an envelope sweeps, started by a gate, by notes or by the input level.
atomik.envelope-follower: Turns the level of an audio signal into a control voltage and a gate, passing the audio through.
atomik.eq: A six-band stereo parametric equaliser with a live analyser. Drag the points on the curve to shape the tone.
atomik.feedback: The supported way to send audio back on itself: a loop through it is allowed and is delayed by one batch.
atomik.fm-synth: A four-operator frequency modulation synthesiser. Choose an algorithm, shape each operator and the modulation between them, and play bells, keys and basses.
atomik.gain-tool: Gain, balance, width and mute at one point of a chain, with an optional second stereo input.
atomik.gate: A stereo gate and downward expander with a sidechain key: it closes on quiet signals to remove noise and bleed.
atomik.gate-processor: Converts, divides, delays, lengthens and combines gate signals, so that one trigger can drive many things.
atomik.granular: Plays a sample as a cloud of short grains. Move the position, size, density and pitch to freeze, smear and stretch a sound.
atomik.guitar-amp: A guitar amplifier with a cabinet, chorus, delay and reverb, and five factory setups.
atomik.key-chord: Locks the notes to a scale and plays chords from single notes, with inversions and voicing options.
atomik.line-mixer: Six stereo channels into a stereo master, each with its own level and pan.
atomik.loop-slicer: Plays the slices of one loop from the keys, each slice with its own gain, pan and tuning.
atomik.macro-bank: Eight macro knobs that drive parameters of other devices. It makes no sound; each assignment has its own range and curve.
atomik.master: The master section of the console: the final fader, the compressor, the sends and returns, and the main outputs.
atomik.mastering: The last device of a mix: a multiband compressor, a stereo width control, a true-peak limiter and a loudness meter in one.
atomik.midi-out: Sends notes and controllers to a MIDI output port, so a hardware synth or another program plays what a track holds.
atomik.mod-source: Two LFOs and an envelope as control voltage sources. It makes no sound: cable its outputs to the parameters you want to move.
atomik.modulation: Chorus, flanger and phaser with tempo sync, rate, depth, feedback and mix.
atomik.mono-bass: A monophonic bass synthesiser built on the Poly Synth voice, with defaults for single low lines. A patch of one carries over to the other.
atomik.note-delay: Moves every note later in time and never adds one, so a track plays a little behind the others.
atomik.note-filter: Transposes and filters the notes that pass through it: a key range, a velocity range and a channel.
atomik.note-repeater: An echo for notes: every note passes as played and adds repeats, for rolls and ratchets.
atomik.note-split: Routes one notes input to up to eight outputs by key and velocity range. It lives inside containers and is never added by hand.
atomik.organ: A drawbar organ with nine drawbars, percussion, key click, a vibrato and chorus scanner and an overdrive. Send it to the Rotary Speaker for the classic sound.
atomik.phase-meter: A stereo and level meter that passes the audio through: goniometer, correlation, balance, width, peaks, RMS and loudness.
atomik.pitch-shifter: A real-time pitch shifter of up to an octave either way, with a fixed latency that is reported to the song.
atomik.poly-synth: A subtractive synthesiser with up to 16 voices: two oscillators and noise, two filters, envelopes, two LFOs, glide, chorus and echo, and a modulation matrix. A good first instrument.
atomik.reverb: A stereo reverb with three algorithms. Set the size, decay, damping and pre-delay to put a sound in a space.
atomik.rotary-speaker: A rotating speaker cabinet: a horn rotor and a drum rotor in front of two microphones, with slow and fast speeds.
atomik.sample-hold: Samples a control voltage (or noise) at each clock tick and holds it until the next.
atomik.sampler: A multi-zone sampler: drop samples on the keyboard, set key and velocity ranges, loops, envelopes and a filter, and every zone that matches a note sounds.
atomik.semi-modular: A synthesiser built from patchable parts: oscillators, filters, envelopes and a sequencer, with sockets you can cable to each other.
atomik.slew-limiter: Limits how fast a control voltage may rise and fall, with a separate time for each direction.
atomik.space-reverb: A large, lush reverb for wide ambient tails, with a long decay, diffusion and a duck that clears the tail while the dry sound plays.
atomik.spectrum: A spectrum analyser that passes the audio through untouched, with a reference curve, a spectrogram view and a choice of weightings.
atomik.spider-audio: Four stereo merge inputs and a four-way stereo split, to build parallel audio paths.
atomik.spider-cv: Four trimmed control voltage merge inputs and two split and invert inputs.
atomik.step-sequencer: A transport-synced pattern player. Up to eight patterns of up to 64 steps, each with its own resolution and swing, play one note at a time.
atomik.stereo-delay: A stereo delay with free or tempo-synced time, feedback, dry and wet mix and ping-pong.
atomik.stereo-tool: Polarity, phase rotation, width with a bass bypass, balance, mono and mid and side conversion.
atomik.transient-shaper: Raises or lowers the attack and the sustain of a signal, whatever its level.
atomik.tuner: A chromatic tuner that passes the audio through: it shows the note, the deviation in cents and the frequency.
atomik.vocoder: Imposes the shape of one sound, usually a voice, on another, the classic talking synthesiser.
atomik.wavetable-synth: A synthesiser that plays through tables of waveforms. Move the position to sweep between them, and import or draw your own tables.
